page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-8-lssd is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor using the x86_64 architecture. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The system is equipped with 32 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage is bundled as a single local NVMe SSD with a capacity of 402 GB. No GPU accelerators are included in this configuration.

Benchmark results indicate strong single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core tests placing in the top 25% at 2863.28. Multi-core CPU performance, Geekbench scores, and database operations fall within the average range. However, a significant hardware tradeoff is observed in memory bandwidth for large, uncached blocks. Large-block read-only memory bandwidth is weak at 36.05 GB/sec, and large-block write bandwidth is poor, registering at 13.63 GB/sec. Small-block cached read bandwidth remains average at 565.78 GB/sec.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the inclusion of a dedicated local NVMe SSD provides high-speed local storage without requiring separate network-attached storage fees, optimizing resource density for disk-heavy operations. The instance is suited for general-purpose workloads, static web serving, text processing, and database operations that fit within its 32 GB memory limit and do not require sustained high-throughput large-block memory operations.
